name: Nanjing Pharmaceutical Group Company Limited
summary: Nanjing Pharmaceutical Group Company Limited engages in the distribution of pharmaceuticals, medical devices, and health products in China. It also involved in the wholesale and retail of pharmaceuticals; provision of internet + Chinese medicine pharmacy service platform; and pharmaceutical third-party logistics services. The company was formerly known as NanJing Pharmaceutical Company Limited and change its name to Nanjing Pharmaceutical Group Company Limited in December 2025. Nanjing Pharmaceutical Group Company Limited was founded in 1951 and is based in Nanjing, China.
